notes.title: Official Korean Language Patch
notes.notes:
Dear Nurse Love Addiction fans,

Thank you for all the support throughout the years. To make more people able to experience this title in their native language, we are happy to announce that we have added official Korean language support! 

We hope this can improve the overall experience, and if you have any suggestions on this update, please feel free to share them with us.

Cheers,

notes.title: Visual Novel/Music Game, Symphonic Rain, Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25296213/2eef01252ad1b32fb22cf92bb87932338544f43e.png[/img]
[b]It's time to dust off your Fortelle and find a vocal partner because the Symphonic Rain HD Remaster is now available for purchase![/b]

Play the definitive version of the 2004 Visual Novel/Music game classic from KOGADO Studio, with visuals remastered in beautiful high-def by original character artist Siro. Also available for the first time (officially) in English!

Set in Piova, the city of music and endless rain, guide Chris Vertin on the path to become a Fortenist—a master of the magical instrument known as the Fortelle. Play music sections with different vocal partners set to the beautiful melodies composed and sung by Ritsuko Okazaki. Experience multiple endings based on your choices and performances. 

When the sound of Chris's playing harmonizes with the voice of the musical magic fairy, who knows what might happen? Play now and find out!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/629650/Symphonic_Rain/

Find more information along with messages from the staff on the official website: http://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/sr2017/en/

notes.title: HD Remaster of Music Visual Novel Game, Symphonic Rain, Coming to Steam June 14, 2017!
notes.notes:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/629650/Symphonic_Rain/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25296213/2eef01252ad1b32fb22cf92bb87932338544f43e.png[/img][/url]
The HD edition of [i]Symphonic Rain[/i] is coming to Steam [b]June 14, 2017[/b]! All 100+ pictures have been modified by original character artist, Shiro, in this remastered version of the popular music adventure game. Available for the first time officially in English!

The setting is the city of music and endless rain; Piova. Play as Chris Vertin, a student of the Piova Communal School of Music, as he prepares for his final examination in which he has to play the magic instrument, the Fortelle, with a vocal partner. When the sound of Chris's playing harmonizes with the voice of the musical magic fairy that lives in his room, who knows what might happen?

A poignant drama, multiple endings, remastered HD artwork, beautiful melodies set to the sound of the rain, and a harmonious fusion of Visual Novel and Music-based gameplay. Experience Kogado Studio's [i]Symphonic Rain[/i] June 14, 2017!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/629650/Symphonic_Rain/

notes.title: Nurse Love Addiction Release Postponed to July 7th
notes.notes:
With a heavy heart we at Degica have decided to postpone the release of Nurse Love Addiction. 

During our final checks of the game, we felt certain elements of the game did not match the quality the release deserves or really show off what the story has to offer. As such we've postponed the release until July 7th, to make sure the game reaches you in its best possible state.

We at Degica Games are dedicated to releasing the best games we can, and while we understand that no one likes delays, we felt it preferable to releasing a game we were not proud of.
